evolisca_tokens.name: Evolisca Tokens
evolisca_tokens.description: Currency used to remove upgrade points from items. Cost: 1 token per 1 attribute point removed

boss_points.name: Boss Points
boss_points.description: Earned by defeating bosses (100% from daily/weekly/world bosses, 10% from hourly/event bosses, 20% from Bosses Orb)

monster_points.name: Monster Points
monster_points.description: Earned by completing task bosses (Level 1000+). Bloodback is the major source.

pvp_points.name: PvP Points
pvp_points.description: Earned by killing players in PvP combat. Can also be obtained by converting 3 Boss Points to 1 PvP Point.
